summary: This clipped note is a Nav2 documentation page, but only its navigation menu was captured, so the tutorial body is missing. The visible outline is for the tutorial 'Writing a New Behavior Tree Plugin', with sections Overview, Requirements, and Tutorial Steps (creating a BT plugin, exporting the planner plugin, adding the plugin library name to config, and running the custom plugin). The rest of the note is site navigation for Nav2 guides, concepts, configuration, and related tutorials. The note's content cannot be summarized beyond this outline.
one_line: Outline of the Nav2 tutorial on writing a new behavior tree plugin, captured from a navigation-only web clip.
